unit: percent of the frame's width, measured from the frame's top-left corner; viewport 1440 wide, overview page, default variant

frame.backdrop: pale lilac-grey backdrop with a soft peach sweep rising from the lower left, visible through the frosted frame and cards

nav.note: white pill of six tabs in the frame's top bar

greeting.note: small greeting line, about 2% tall, not a big headline

kpis.note: row of four short tiles; value and label fill the tile

chart-bar.note: wide stacked hatched blocks, one column per month; not thin bars

chart-axis.note: y-axis labels ($0 to $1.2k) left of the bars

chart-tip.note: tooltip with two values above the May column

emails.note: Recent emails starts directly under the chart, same column

formation.note: Formation status card, top of the right column

success.note: Success rate card with title, arrow button, gauge, two stats

gauge.note: segmented half gauge, about three quarters of the success card's width

kpi-value.note: the tile's number on one line (dollars and cents together), about 28px tall at 1440

formation-cta.note: full-width 'View status' button at the bottom of the formation card

success-stats.note: Peoples and New users row sits right under the gauge text, no empty band above it

kpi-label.note: label directly under the number; number and label sit in the middle of the tile under the icon, not pushed to the bottom with an empty band

topbar-actions.note: phone, calendar, search, bell, then a photo avatar with a chevron

requirements.text: Every nav tab (Dashboard, Finance, Accounts, HR and Payroll, Peoples, Contracts) opens its own working page with real content
Cards are frosted glass over the backdrop, not solid white; the peach sweep shows through
Tile numbers stay on one line, including $3,287.49
Header matches the reference: logo mark, tab pill, four icon buttons, avatar
